affected_subject.reason: MEVCapture extension fee logic for ExactIn vs ExactOut swaps is identified.

trigger_or_action.reason: Performing an ExactIn swap vs an equivalent ExactOut swap triggers the differing fee computation.

direct_effect.reason: ExactIn users pay a higher effective fee / are overcharged versus ExactOut for identical trades (e.g., 4,790 token difference).

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected equivalence of fees for equivalent trades is violated by computing additional fee on reduced vs full base.

summary: Report identifies MEVCapture fee asymmetry, the swap-type trigger, the concrete overcharge effect, and the inconsistent fee-base relation supporting an expected-vs-actual safety comparison.
